title: Identity and pasting laws of the derived square isomorphism
statement:
Use the derived square isomorphisms $\theta^D_\square:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ of cartesian squares $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-iso] (here $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, functors $\Dplus(Y_{\Et})\to\Dplus(X'_{\Et})$), and the composition and identity isomorphisms $c^D$, $e^D$ of the derived inverse images [lem-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-composition]. Outer rectangles of pasted cartesian squares are cartesian squares [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting].

1. (Identity square.) For $f:X\to Y$ and the square $\square_f=(f,f,\mathrm{id}_Y,\mathrm{id}_X)$: $\theta^D_{\square_f}=((e^D_X)^{-1}f^{-1})\circ(f^{-1}e^D_Y):f^{-1}\mathrm{id}_Y^{-1}\to f^{-1}\to\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}f^{-1}$.
2. (Horizontal pasting.) For $\square_1=(f,f',g,g')$ and a cartesian square $\square_2=(f',f'',h,h')$ with $h:Y''\to Y'$, $h':X''\to X'$, $f'':X''\to Y''$, and the outer rectangle $\square_2\cdot\square_1=(f,f'',g\circ h,g'\circ h')$:
$$
 \theta^D_{\square_2\cdot\square_1}\circ(f''^{-1}c^D_{g,h})=(c^D_{g',h'}f^{-1})\circ(h'^{-1}\theta^D_{\square_1})\circ(\theta^D_{\square_2}g^{-1}):\ f''^{-1}h^{-1}g^{-1}\to(g'h')^{-1}f^{-1}.
$$
3. (Vertical pasting.) For $\square_1$ as above and a cartesian square $\square_3=(e,e',g',g'')$ with $e:W\to X$, $e':W'\to X'$, $g'':W'\to W$, and the outer rectangle $\square_1\circ\square_3=(f\circ e,f'\circ e',g,g'')$:
$$
 \theta^D_{\square_1\circ\square_3}\circ(c^D_{f',e'}g^{-1})=(g''^{-1}c^D_{f,e})\circ(\theta^D_{\square_3}f^{-1})\circ(e'^{-1}\theta^D_{\square_1}):\ e'^{-1}f'^{-1}g^{-1}\to g''^{-1}(fe)^{-1}.
$$
The same three identities hold for the sheaf-level isomorphisms $\theta_\square$ with $c,e$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].

proof.text: Express the derived comparison of a commutative square as (upperStarCompDerivedPlus for its lower-left path).symm followed by upperStarCompDerivedPlus for its upper-right path, with a common diagonal. This is pullbackSquareComparison_eq; substitution allows any equal chosen diagonal. All maps are already on the bounded-below derived categories.

For the identity square on f choose the common diagonal f. The right and left derived unit laws identify the two composition comparisons with the corresponding whiskered identity comparisons. Compose with the identity comparison, cancel its inverse, and obtain identity (1).

Take the component of derived associativity for a triple of arrows and rearrange it by canceling invertible morphisms. The two rearranged forms identify map(composition.hom) followed by composition.inv, and composition.hom followed by map(composition.inv). For horizontal pasting apply them to (f double prime,h,g), (h prime,f prime,g), and (h prime,g prime,f), choosing the intermediate diagonals using the two commutativity equations. The internal comparison maps and inverses cancel. This expresses the outer square comparison as the horizontal composite with the source and target composition isomorphisms. Precompose with the mapped inverse source comparison and cancel it to obtain (2).

Use the same rearranged associativity component equations for (e prime,f prime,g), (e prime,g prime,f), and (g double prime,e,f). Commutativity of the squares identifies the intermediate diagonals, and the internal comparison maps cancel. This expresses the outer square comparison as the vertical composite with the source and target composition isomorphisms. Precompose with the inverse source comparison and cancel it to obtain (3). Specialize the three proved identities from arbitrary Grothendieck abelian coefficients to AddCommGrpCat. The sheaf-level identities mentioned at the end of the node are already the source declarations squareUpperStarIso_id and squareUpperStarIso_paste_horiz_hom / squareUpperStarIso_paste_vert_hom; no duplicate declarations are needed. In Lean, cancel the source comparison inside each generic component lemma, assemble the three formulas with all local functor notation expanded, and specialize to abelian groups. Expanding P, theta, c and i in the public statement is only beta/zeta reduction and inverse projection, preventing costly kernel conversions after the upstream sync.

Proof in five steps: (1) the sheaf-level laws, split off as the new node lem-weil-pbc-square-iso-pasting (unsplit; its Lean is the sorry-free source declarations Etale.squareUpperStarIso_paste_horiz_hom, _paste_vert_hom, squareUpperStarIso_id); (2) a dictionary on D: theta^D_unb, c^D, e^D lift theta, c, e through the composite identifications Phi^w built from phi, and lifting is compatible with composition, inverses, left and right whiskering (naturality of phi and of the transformations); (3) hence both sides of each identity on D agree at every QK; (4) equality on D by the uniqueness clause (3) of the localization leaf (categories.tex 04VG (3)); (5) restriction to D^+. The source Lean has no derived-level version (no pullbackSquareComparison_paste_* / _id; its derived pasting laws for the base change map go through derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_ext instead). theorem derivedSquareIsoPasting :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (IsPullback.id_horiz f).toCommSq).hom.app K =
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((upperStarIdDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).hom.app K) ≫
          (upperStarIdDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).inv.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ∧
    (∀ {X Y X' Y' X'' Y'' : Scheme.{u}}
        {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
        {f'' : X'' ⟶ Y''} {h : Y'' ⟶ Y'} {h' : X'' ⟶ X'}
        (sq₁ : IsPullback g' f' f g) (sq₂ : IsPullback h' f'' f' h)
        (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f'').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h g).inv.app K) ≫
          (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (sq₂.paste_horiz sq₁).toCommSq).hom.app K =
        (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₂.toCommSq).hom.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₁.toCommSq).hom.app K) ≫
          (upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h' g').inv.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ∧
    (∀ {X Y X' Y' W W' : Scheme.{u}}
        {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
        {e : W ⟶ X} {e' : W' ⟶ X'} {g'' : W' ⟶ W}
        (sq₁ : IsPullback g' f' f g) (sq₃ : IsPullback g'' e' e g')
        (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      (upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} e' f').inv.app
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
          (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (sq₃.paste_vert sq₁).toCommSq).hom.app K =
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} e').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₁.toCommSq).hom.app K) ≫
          (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₃.toCommSq).hom.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g'').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
            ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} e f).inv.app K))
